title: It Was a JoJo
about: An AD meeting interrupted by water raining through the ceiling because Jordan and Reece were using a hose in the boys' dorm shower.
description: This track turns one ridiculous Prep Week night into an indoor rain mystery. During an AD meeting, water suddenly began pouring through the ceiling across the room. After tracing the likely source to the boys' dorm showers, Rey and Aaron went upstairs to investigate. They returned with the explanation: Jordan, known as JoJo, and Reece had been using a hose in the shower. What looked like a plumbing disaster downstairs turned out to be another unforgettable piece of Prep Week chaos.
